title: White wooden cottage with front porch and pointed gable window
observations: The main building features vertical white siding and a gable roof with the ridge running front-to-back relative to the extended length, making the primary gabled facade face the front.
A covered porch extends along the front with slender white support posts and a shallow roof.
A distinctive arched gothic-style window is centered in the upper gable.
A pair of rectangular windows is located on the ground floor of the front facade.
assumptions: The rear depth and back wall structure are symmetrical to the front porch length.
Internal room layouts are inferred based on exterior window positions.

volumes.evidence: Main white rectangular body with visible gable roof.
Shallow porch roof extending over the front deck.

details.evidence: Pointed arched window in the front gable peak.
Pair of rectangular double-hung windows on the main front floor.
